summary.text: Conor Casey is a Democrat who has represented Washington-4 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2023.
He sits on the House Committee on Corrections and Institutions and the Judicial Retention Committee.

paragraphs.text: Growing up in both Ireland and the United States, Casey developed an appreciation for workers' rights and political activism at an early age, according to his House biography.
He received a BA in Media Arts from Emerson College in Boston and an MA in Communications from Dublin City University.
After returning to the United States, Casey worked briefly in the office of Senator Ted Kennedy before becoming Political Director of the Vermont State Employees' Association.
He has served as Executive Director of the Vermont Democratic Party and most recently held organizing roles with the Connecticut Education Association and the Vermont NEA.
Casey is Executive Director of GunSense Vermont, a non-profit working to reduce gun violence, and chairs Vermont's Irish American Legislative Caucus.
He lives in Montpelier, where he served three terms on the City Council, and is a member of the Homelessness Task Force.
